style_modifiers_global: split-panel two-column layout, thin vertical divider line, left panel shows a glossy 3D bubble numeral with cute googly cartoon eyes and a smile on a soft light gray background, right panel shows the matching count of one glossy 3D or friendly cartoon object with cute faces, each object clearly separated with visible gaps (never overlapping or clustered), on a bold flat-color background, small colored number badge in the corner of the right panel, clean commercial 3D render style, soft shadows, no photorealistic humans, no scary or ambiguous expressions --ar 1:1 --style raw --v 6
background_constraints: left panel: solid soft light gray background. Right panel: single bold flat color background (rotating through yellow, blue, green, orange, pink, teal, purple across the book), no clutter, no props beyond the counted objects, objects spaced clearly apart for counting
character_reference: Consistent cute-face treatment: large round googly cartoon eyes with eyelashes, simple curved black-line smile, applied identically to every numeral and every object across all 10 pages
